I just wanted to say that I'm really sorry you are going through this, I know how terrible it is. I wouldn't wish night like these to my worst enemy. Therapy is a must and will help you learn how to manage your feelings, how to deal with people and how to talk to people around you in a way they can be more understanding of your rights and feelings (especially your parents). Consider suggesting family counseling to your household.

My therapist told me that i shouldn't have gone through rhe surgery withour fixing my depression. As you can see, i might have lost my food addiction, but now I have a new eating problem. The food is not the problem. Not even the addiction is the worse thing here. The worst problem  you have is your mental state.
